messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — Liam's birthday is this Friday (3/28). Planning a small drop-in celebration at 3pm in the kitchen. Do we want cake, doughnuts, or bagels? Remote folks we'll send e-gift cards.
people-ops-bot: FYI — budget code for snacks: `POPS-23`. Please add your reactions and say if you can bring anything.
Dan: cake :cake: — I can bring plates & forks.
Aisha: doughnuts :doughnut: — happy to pick them up from the bakery near HQ.
Samir: bagels :bagel: + I'll bring coffee (2 large urns).
Tori: cake would be lovely but can we include a vegan option? :pray:
Jen: I'll coordinate the order. Can folks drop any dietary restrictions here by Thursday EOD? I'll post the order link after that.
Maria: tagging @people-ops — also can someone volunteer to take photos? we like a group pic for the #memes channel. :camera_with_flash:
Dan: I can take photos. quick question: do we have a cake knife in the office kit or should I bring one?
Aisha: there's a utensil drawer in the pantry with a serrated knife, but bringing one is safer.
people-ops-bot: Poll created — react with your snack choice: :cake: for cake, :doughnut: for doughnuts, :bagel: for bagels. Poll open until Thu 5pm.
Samir: :bagel: (bringing coffee)
Tori: :cake: (vegan please)
Jen: Noted — I'll add vegan and GF labels. Also planning to send e-gift cards to remote folks — recommended amount $15 unless anyone objects.
Maria: $15 sounds great.
Dan: fine by me.
Aisha: agree.
Jen: Order link (will update once poll closes): https://forms.gle/xxxxxx — please fill dietary prefs there.
Maria: Thanks Jen! If anyone wants to chip in for a better cake (fancy bakery) drop a note here and I can collect. If not, we'll do standard.
Dan: I'll chip in $10.
Samir: I can add $5.
Tori: happy to add $5.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for Fri 10:00am: "Birthday celebration for Liam at 3pm in kitchen".
Jen: Awesome — I'll pick up the goodies and be there at 2:30pm to set up.
Maria: Lovely. Remote folks — we'll DM you the gift card. Thanks everyone! :tada:
